nodes.description: State variable holding the IEtherFreaker interface instance at 0x3A27...0f33 used for external calls.
Payable constructor that buys a birth certificate for owner then selfdestructs.
External payable call _etherFreaker.birthTo{value: msg.value}(owner) to an untrusted contract.
selfdestruct(owner) forwards the entire balance; dangerous control transfer.
State variable holding the IEtherFreaker interface used to read prices and token counts.
Immutable payable owner address, derived from tx.origin, receiving refunds.
Immutable CREATE2 init code hash built from FreakerBirther creation code and tx.origin.
Constructor that sets owner from tx.origin and computes initCodeHash.
View function computing the ether cost of birthing a full set of 8 Freakers.
View function brute-forcing CREATE2 salts to find the best 8 Freaker combination.
Payable function that deploys 8 FreakerBirther contracts and refunds the owner.
Internal view function computing the CREATE2 deployment address for a given salt.
Internal view pseudo-random function based on block.timestamp, caller and salt modulo n.
Attacker-controllable transaction origin used as owner and as CREATE2 init code input.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as the only entropy source for randomness.
Low-level owner.call{value: address(this).balance} transfer of all funds to an external address.
Payable recipient passed to the FreakerBirther constructor.

Derived fortune value compared against the stored best.
Per-item cost accumulated from _etherFreaker.middlePrice().
Memory array of 8 FreakerBirtherInfo entries selected in birthSet.
Counter of accepted Freaker slots in birthSet.
Salt brute-forced in birthSet and used as the CREATE2 salt.
Predicted deployment address derived from the current salt.
Derived species index used to bucket Freakers.
Derived fortune value compared against the stored best.
Value forwarded to each CREATE2 deployment.
Success flag of the low-level owner.call refund.

Raw random roll mapped to a species bucket in birthSet.
CREATE2 deployment of eight FreakerBirther contracts using user-influenced salt and value.

edges.reason: The birthTo external call is executed on the _etherFreaker instance.
birthingCost reads numTokens and birthCertificates prices from _etherFreaker.
findSet reads middlePrice from _etherFreaker.
birthSet reads middlePrice from _etherFreaker.
middlePrice result flows into the cost local variable.
The owner state variable supplies the target address of the value call, whose result depends on state held by owner.
initCodeHash is consumed by the CREATE2 address computation in _findCaller.
The constructor writes the immutable owner value.
The constructor writes the immutable initCodeHash value.
owner is assigned directly from tx.origin, letting the transaction initiator control the refund recipient.
initCodeHash is derived from tx.origin, making CREATE2 addresses depend on the untrusted origin.
The Freakonomics constructor reads tx.origin as its only identity input.
Randomness is derived solely from block.timestamp, which is influenceable by miners.
The predicted deployment address returned by _findCaller is used inside the findSet loop.
The predicted deployment address returned by _findCaller is used inside the birthSet loop.
The pseudo-random output determines species and fortune in findSet.
The pseudo-random output determines species and fortune in birthSet.
The owner parameter is consumed by the constructor body.
The owner parameter is the recipient argument of the birthTo external call.
The owner parameter is the beneficiary of selfdestruct.
minimumFortune bounds the fortune acceptance check in findSet.
minimumFortune bounds the fortune acceptance check in birthSet.
creationSalt is packed into the CREATE2 hash inside _findCaller.
salt is packed into the randomness hash.
caller is packed into the randomness hash.
n is the modulus applied to the randomness hash.
totalCertificates drives the branch and index selection in birthingCost.
totalCost is the accumulated return value of birthingCost.
initialGas snapshots gasleft before the search loop.
foundFreakers controls the main search loop condition.
creationSalt is incremented each iteration of the search loop.
caller holds the predicted address used for randomness seeding.
species indexes the freakers array slot to update.
fortune is compared with the stored best fortune.
cost accumulates the sum returned as totalCost.
speciesDie is mapped into a species bucket.
freakers is the memory array filled by the birthSet loop.
foundFreakers controls the main search loop condition in birthSet.
creationSalt is incremented each iteration of the search loop.
caller holds the predicted address used for randomness seeding.
species indexes the freakers array slot to update.
fortune is compared with the stored best fortune.
cost is the value attached to each CREATE2 deployment.
ok is the success flag of the owner refund call.
speciesDie is mapped into a species bucket in birthSet.
The chosen creationSalt becomes the CREATE2 salt of the deployment.
The computed cost is forwarded as msg.value to each CREATE2 deployment.
The constructor body invokes the external birthTo call.
The constructor terminates by executing selfdestruct.
findSet calls _findCaller inside its search loop.
birthSet calls _findCaller inside its search loop.
birthSet requires msg.value to be at least birthingCost().
birthSet performs a full-balance external value transfer to owner at the end of execution.
birthSet deploys the eight FreakerBirther contracts via CREATE2.
The CREATE2 deployment executes the FreakerBirther constructor, which itself makes an external call and selfdestructs.
A malicious owner contract can reenter birthSet from the value-transfer fallback before the loop state is finalized.
